incompatibility: FIN-013 rejects any 'refund' to a donor after acceptance; card network rules let the issuer reverse an accepted gift without sponsor consent.
recommended_resolution: Classify network-initiated reversals as InvoluntaryReversal outside FIN-013's scope; FIN-013 governs only sponsor-initiated value movement.

incompatibility: Completed-gift date for cards may be the charge date while TVR-CON-001 keeps value Provisional up to 120+ days; acknowledgment gating (RR-UNB-ACC-006-r1) may then delay acknowledgments past donor filing needs.
recommended_resolution: Separate acknowledgment eligibility (completed gift + acceptance) from grantable capacity (reversal window); allow acknowledgment before window end with correction workflow per counsel.

incompatibility: Idempotency keyed by rule version plus mandatory deterministic rebuild permits regenerating posted journals under new rules.
recommended_resolution: RR-ACC-MDL-007-r1: journals are persisted facts; rebuild applies to projections only; re-derivation is a control (UNB-XIN-ACC-003).

incompatibility: AI recommending portfolios conflicts with keeping legal/advisory classification explicit; operator lacks charitable adviser exemption.
recommended_resolution: RR-UNB-INV-019-r1 with counsel decision XID-INV-004.

incompatibility: r1 permits WorkItems only for four system causes; ENT-016 requires reconsideration cases initiated by donors/charities (also ADM-015 intake).
recommended_resolution: RR-REQ-X-048-r2 adds cause (e).

incompatibility: One shared case lifecycle vs per-case retention/legal-hold/privacy policies.
recommended_resolution: Kernel + CaseProfile (UNB-XIN-SVC-002).

incompatibility: Terminal objects never reopen vs metrics/flows for reopened cases (also EXC-18).
recommended_resolution: Decisions follow SM-0; work cases reopen within profile window.

incompatibility: UNB-ACC-010 requires 'billing, collections' generally; collections from donors against fund fees are impossible because fees are deducted and value cannot return to donors; donor-paid fees are outside fund ledgers.
recommended_resolution: UNB-XIN-ERP-002 payer-source discriminator; collections apply only to PartnerInvoice and DonorExternal.

incompatibility: UNB-ACC-013 requires native AR/invoicing; RCD-013 recommends integrating AR except partner fee billing.
recommended_resolution: Narrow UNB-ACC-013 to partner/sponsor invoices (XID-ERP-003).

incompatibility: ADM-008 allows 'household collaboration' without limits; ONT-2 states households confer no access.
recommended_resolution: RR-ADM-008-r1.

incompatibility: GRT-001 rejects natural-person benefit in every tier with no override absent future counsel route; Temp. Reg. §1.530A-7T makes DAF general funding contributions to Trump accounts lawful and not natural-person distributions.
recommended_resolution: Add a separate disabled-by-default class (UNB-XIN-NPG-007); keep class (f) unchanged.

incompatibility: UNB-GRANT-026 implies onboarding and acknowledgment collection for grantees; REQ-X-058 warns against forcing registration before every grant.
recommended_resolution: RR-UNB-GRANT-026-r1.

incompatibility: RR-UNB-PLAT-008-r1 makes Profile B (database per tenant) default and Profile A (schema per tenant) exception-only; RCD-004 recommends one database per legal sponsor with distribution partners as separate schemas by default. If tenant = partner they conflict; if tenant = sponsor, partner schemas are a sub-tenant partition not covered by the refinement.
recommended_resolution: Close RCD-004 with tenant = legal sponsor and amend RR-UNB-PLAT-008-r1 to name partner schemas inside a sponsor database as the default partner partition.

incompatibility: RR-REQ-X-036-r1: 'Expiry MUST create a disposition review task'; RCD-007 recommends class-level batches, not per-record human review.
recommended_resolution: Adopt RR-REQ-X-038-r1 (batch per class and trigger period; per-record review only for rule-flagged exceptions).

incompatibility: UNB-TEN-016 gives each partner an exportable dataset and portability protocol; UNB-SUCC-014 and RR-UNB-WF-014-r1 say cross-sponsor portability is never automatic and transfers are sponsor distributions. A partner export of donor data by default could enable moving relationships without sponsor authority.
recommended_resolution: RR-UNB-TEN-016-r1: export goes to the legal sponsor; partner receives only sponsor-authorized data; fund moves only via UNB-XIN-SAS-007.

incompatibility: UNB-ACC-014 places allocation methodologies inside the full accounting system (implying postable allocations); UNB-XIN-ECO-001 requires management attribution to be non-posting.
recommended_resolution: Adopt RR-UNB-ACC-014-r1: only CPA-approved functional allocations and approved billing post; management attribution is projection.

incompatibility: AIN-028 "without silently abandoning work" can be read as requiring completion beyond budget; ECO-009 stops model calls at budget.
recommended_resolution: RR-AIN-028-r1: stopping is not abandoning when state persists and work routes to a human queue with Incomplete status.

incompatibility: REQ-X-042 Tier A permits auto-deployment of reversible non-financial UX changes; ECO-016 requires counter-metric floors before any cost-saving credit or ratchet.
recommended_resolution: Compatible if Tier A deploys may proceed but their savings are credited only after ECO-016 verification; no change to Tier A authority.

requirement_a: UNB-DATA-004 (all current state is a projection of immutable records); architecture/TENANT-AWARE-PERSISTENCE-DESIGN.md:18 (all committed business facts immutable)
incompatibility: Engagement data held as immutable events cannot be erased; crypto-shredding becomes mandatory for routine CRM changes
recommended_resolution: RR-UNB-DATA-004-r1 storage classes; XID-EVA-007

requirement_a: UNB-DATA-001 (no UPDATE/DELETE of committed authoritative records)
incompatibility: Outbox delivery status and process steps require updates; literal reading forbids them
recommended_resolution: Classify as operational coordination state (RR-UNB-DATA-004-r1 class 3)

requirement_a: REQ-X-022 / TX-11 (approval and reservation atomic); REQ-X-083 (orthogonal payment states)
requirement_b: Echelon generated DAF architecture: GrantApprovalRecorded consumed asynchronously by redemption, payment and accounting; PaymentRecorded single event (Echelon-AI-Native-Enterprise-Design-Framework:case-studies/daf/generated/analysis.md:160,165)
incompatibility: Generator replaces the atomic reservation with event handoffs and collapses payment knowledge states
recommended_resolution: Unbound requirements prevail; record as Echelon framework feedback: EventContract needs authority and consistency attributes

incompatibility: Two catalogs name the same facts differently
recommended_resolution: Resolve in GEX-ADR-001 using event-matrix.jsonl crosswalk

requirement_a: UNB-TEC-STRATA-003 / UNB-GEX-002 (Strata role in authoritative event persistence)
requirement_b: UNB-XIN-EVA-001 (journal is the financial event log; no parallel event store)
incompatibility: Already known as RCF-ARC-001; additionally an event store beneath the journal would duplicate financial truth
recommended_resolution: Adopt RR-UNB-PLAT-007-r1 with the journal declared authoritative

requirement_a: COMPONENT-OWNERSHIP matrix T3 (statements as eventual projections)
incompatibility: Eventual projection allows non-reproducible statements
recommended_resolution: Statements are deterministic artifacts of sealed snapshots; dashboards remain T3

incompatibility: Two event envelopes are specified: SAS-005 (TenantId, LegalSponsorId, ProgramId, tenant-scoped sequence, CorrelationId, CausationId) and EVA-006 (correlation_root, causation_id, business_keys, parent_root) plus RR-UNB-EVT-001-r1 (authority class). Field names and the meaning of 'correlation' differ.
recommended_resolution: Adopt one envelope: tenant fields from SAS-005; correlation_root, parent_root, causation_id and business_keys from EVA-006; authority_class from RR-UNB-EVT-001-r1. CorrelationId in SAS-005 is renamed correlation_root. Tenant-scoped sequence is advisory ordering only, never a completeness watermark (EVA-007).

incompatibility: ERP-007 classifies events as AuthoritativeFinancial / AuthoritativeAuthority / Informational; the event matrix and RR-UNB-EVT-001-r1 use authoritative-financial / authoritative-nonfinancial / derived / informational / observation-ai. Two vocabularies for one classification.
recommended_resolution: Use the event-matrix vocabulary (five classes). Map AuthoritativeAuthority to authoritative-nonfinancial. ERP-007's substantive rule (only the fee engine emits authoritative fee events) is retained.

incompatibility: Holds are specified in three places: EVA-010 typed hold model, NPG-006 discretionary hold governance, CLM-004 restricted investigation cases (which may place holds), and SVC-002's case kernel references holds through case profiles. Without a rule, a case could carry hold semantics.
recommended_resolution: Holds are domain records of EVA-010 types only. A case (SVC-002/CLM-004) may request or reference a hold but never is one; NPG-006 discretionary holds are the EVA-010 'DiscretionaryHold' type with NPG-006 governance fields.
